Free Masterclass: The Hidden Link Between Snoring, Mouth Breathing & Sleep Apnea
If you snore, mouth breathe, wake up tired, or rely on CPAP, this matters. In this free 75-minute masterclass, Dr. Doug breaks down how breathing mechanics, tongue posture, and airway function quietly sabotage your sleep and what you can start doing differently. This is the foundation behind The Exhale Method™ and the Breathing Gym. It is where real change begins, not quick fixes.
